evals.name: habits-resource-full
evals.prompt: I scaffolded my habit tracker. Now I need to wire up Firestore for the habits collection. Each habit has a name, an array of completedDates (ISO date strings), and a createdAt timestamp. Make a hook to list habits, fetch one by id, and create new ones. Feature folder is src/page/habits.
evals.expected_output: habits-service.ts in src/services/, use-habits.ts + use-habit.ts + use-create-habit.ts in src/page/habits/hooks/, habit.interface.ts in src/page/habits/interfaces/. All hooks use React Query. Service is the only file importing firebase/firestore.

evals.name: journal-entries-no-mutation
evals.prompt: Add a Firestore data layer for journal entries. Fields: id, title, body, mood (one of 'happy'|'neutral'|'sad'), createdAt. Read-only for now, no create hook needed. Feature folder is src/page/journal.
evals.expected_output: entries-service.ts, use-entries.ts, use-entry.ts, entry.interface.ts. Mood is a union type. No use-create-entry.ts generated.

evals.name: workouts-with-nested-types
evals.prompt: Wire up Firestore for workouts. A workout has id, name, durationMinutes, exercises (an array of objects with name, sets, reps, weight), and createdAt. Generate a mutation hook too. Feature folder: src/page/workouts.
evals.expected_output: workouts-service.ts, use-workouts.ts, use-workout.ts, use-create-workout.ts, workout.interface.ts with nested exercise type. The interface handles the complex shape.
